description:
Inspect a public domain across DNS, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, email posture and AI-agent discovery surfaces, including robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP, x402 and Agent Card availability.
USE WHEN: an agent needs a single-call observational check of a domain's surfaces or wants to compare with a previous state.
DO NOT USE WHEN: protocol validation, Agent Card/A2A validation, MCP compliance validation, security certification, or a consumption guarantee. **USE `domain-risk-trust-decision` FOR:** merchant/domain trust.
Operational behavior: no tool-specific auth or rate limit; remote surfaces may throttle requests.
Parameter semantics: `domain` is required; optional `previous_state` is a prior `new_state` from this product vs the current observation to detect material changes in `changes`.

domain.description: Bare public domain for consolidated domain health, DNS, TLS, and email-posture inspection; no protocol or path; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

previous_state.description: Optional prior new_state returned by this product for stateless change detection.
previous_state.title: Previous State

name: domain_agent_discovery_check

email_posture.description: Observed email posture including MX, SPF, and DMARC.

health.description: Observed domain health: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, redirects, TLS, and latency.

security_posture.description: Observed HTTPS/TLS security posture; not a safety verdict.

title: Domain & Agent Discovery Check
